Cosmology is not Astronomy. Cosmology is theoretical astronomy, studying mainly the gravitational field through general relativity.

In this direction, the department studies the phenomenology of the universe in different epochs using various gravity models.

This direction currently includes: Dr. Võ Quốc Phong.

Courses to follow this research direction:

1. General and foundational subjects of the field

2. Gravitational Field Theory, Field Theory

3. Computational Methods in Theoretical Physics

For more detail on the works and specific problems, please refer to the Research Directions section.

Field Theory - Elementary Particles

The Field Theory - Elementary Particles direction studies phenomenology and the unification of the four fundamental interactions (electromagnetic, weak and strong).

This direction currently includes at the department:

Dr. Phan Hồng Khiêm

Dr. Võ Quốc Phong

In addition, there are several lecturers at affiliated institutes and universities such as:

Courses to follow this research direction:

1. General and foundational subjects of the field

2. Field Theory, Elementary Particle Theory

3. Group Theory, Generalized Functions

Condensed Matter Physics

This is the traditional research direction of the Department of Theoretical Physics.

It studies, in depth and breadth, the quantum phenomena of many-body systems, as well as the interaction properties of condensed matter with light.

This research direction currently includes:

Prof. Dr. Nguyễn Quốc Khánh

Dr. Vũ Quang Tuyên

Dr. Nguyễn Hữu Nhã

 

In addition, there are visiting lecturers from other institutes and universities affiliated with the department.

 

Courses to follow this research direction:

1. General and foundational subjects of the field

2. Quantum Mechanics 1, 2

3. Computational Methods in Theoretical Physics

4. Solid State Theory, Semiconductor Optics

5. Many-Body System Theory, Low-Dimensional Systems

For more detail on the works and specific problems, please refer to the Research Directions section.
